Hon'ble Shri Justice Narendra Kumar Vyas Order On Board 04.10.2024
1.

This contempt petition has been filed by the petitioner against non- compliance of this Court's order dated 10.07.2024 passed in WPC No. 2747 of 2024 wherein following order has been passed:-
"Considering facts and circumstances of the case, nature of grievance raised and particularly amount of compensation computed, calcuated and awarded in favor of petitioner has already been deposited and it has been further forwarded in terms of Section 77 the Act of 2013 to the Collector.

Respondent No. 1 and respondent No. 2 are directed to take decision on the pending representation/claim of petitioner at the earliest preferably within a period of three weeks from the date of receipt of this Daya Bai vs Avinash Champawat Secretary on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55763789/
1 order."

2. In pursuance of direction issued by this Court, respondent No. 3/Ms. Digitally signed by ARUN ARUN KUMAR KUMAR DEWANGAN DEWANGAN Date:
2024.10.07 18:19:01 +0530 Neeta Thakur, Registrar of Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, Raipur is present before this Court through video conferencing and would submit that the petitioner has filed an application before the Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority Tribunal for withdrawal of the compensation amount which was deposited with them but the presiding officer is not available, therefore, the amount cannot be given to the petitioner.

entities.text: ARUN ARUN KUMAR KUMAR DEWANGAN DEWANGAN

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that proviso clause to Section 77 (2) of the Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 provides that any person admitted to be interested may receive such payment under protest as to the sufficiency of the amount, therefore, the petitioner may kindly be allowed to receive the amount deposited with the tribunal and the respondents are also directed to give the amount of the petitioner as deposited with them.

entities.text:
Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. In view of the above, the petitioner is directed to prefer appropriate application within 10 days from the date of receipt of copy of this order before respondent No. 3 for withdrawal of the amount deposited with them to the tune of Rs. 8,71,698/- towards compensation of land acquisition of the land belongs to the petitioner.

Thereafter respondent No. 3 will transfer the amount to the Land Acquisition Officer within further 10 days and thereafter, the Land Acquisition Officer will make the payment to the petitioner within further 10 days after due verification and without delay.
5. With the aforesaid observation and direction, the instant contempt petition is disposed of.
